description: This file defines a singleton enum 'BinaryProtocolHolder' that manages an instance of 'BinaryProtocol'. It provides methods to access and create the 'BinaryProtocol' instance, acting as a holder or registry within the package 'com.rusefi.binaryprotocol'.

classes.name: BinaryProtocolHolder
classes.description: An enum singleton that holds a single instance of 'BinaryProtocol' and provides methods to get and create this instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the current 'BinaryProtocol' instance held by the singleton.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new 'BinaryProtocol' instance with the provided 'Logger' and 'IoStream', assigns it to the singleton, and returns it.
